html: צהר (√ of foll.; cf. Arabic ظَهَرَ appear, mount, ظَهْرٌ back, ظَهِيرَةٌ midday; Assyrian ṣêru (TelAm. zuʾru, etc.), back; Aramaic טִיהֲרָא, ܛܰܗܪܳܐ MI:15 הצהרם, midday; LagBN 129; > Köii 1, 93 (cf. Thes) = shine, ‖ זהר, NH Hiph. (rare), for this is in Aramaic צהר (rare)); הִצְהִיר Ecclus 43:3 is denom. from צהרים.
